source_lineage.source: WFP VAM — Kenya: NDVI at Subnational Level (MODIS collection 6.1, Terra+Aqua)
source_lineage.method: Deterministic (_sources/parse_ndvi.py), no LLM/transcription. WFP publishes on the OCHA legacy sub-county grid: admin2 p-codes are KE + county(001-047) + subunit, so the county is exactly the 5-char p-code prefix. County value = PIXEL-WEIGHTED (n_pixels) rollup of the sub-unit NDVI and its long-term mean; the anomaly is recomputed from the rolled-up values (ndvi / ndvi_mean * 100), never averaged directly. County name from the OCHA COD admin1 table; joined to the canonical 47 + gaul1_code via county_key (0 name mismatches after normalization).

maintenance.rollback: Existing data are not modified by packaging; stage a new version and retain prior versions. Source refresh safeguards remain with each source builder.

validation.numerical_check: Domain, key and ratio checks; source lineage retained
